evidence.quote: The primary educational need is Reading Fluency.

Maya has a persistent reading fluency concern. Classroom performance and teacher information indicate difficulty reading connected grade-level text accurately and fluently. The academic evaluation dated 2024-10-18 documents a reading fluency baseline of 42 WCPM and oral reading accuracy of 86%. Reading comprehension during grade-level text tasks is below expected classroom level. Connected-text reading is slow and effortful, with frequent pauses. Isolated word reading is stronger than connected-text reading.
